comment: This module has no manual, no entry in the maker's docs folder and no tooltip names beyond 'some harmonic'; everything here was read from composites/CH10.h. The hundred grid buttons, params 20 to 119, are tagged to the ring modulation line: in the composite the button at column c and row r multiplies harmonic c of A by harmonic r of B. Params 124 and 125, the fine tune controls, have no position on the panel and no line. Every button defaults to 0 and doOutput divides the sum by the number switched on, so with none on there is no output.
